tapmind_source.note: Third automation source repo (tapmind-mobile-tests, NLP framework). Its nav_index is checked in under config/nav_index/tapmind/<module>.json -- a sibling of nav_index/gmt/ and nav_index/gtf/ under the same nav_index/ root; its module->project map lives right alongside those files, at config/nav_index/tapmind/project_map.json (not a separate top-level folder). Namespaced separately because its module names collide with gojek-mobile-tests. TapMind's @TestInfo carries projectId/suiteId/testCaseIds STATICALLY (no per-case Lumos lookup). Project ids below are observed verbatim from @TestInfo/module constants; a bare number N is TapMind's BrowserStack project id -- verify against BrowserStack PR-<N> before treating as authoritative, and note some modules store the value already as 'PR-<N>'. Crucially, TapMind covers the two MERCHANT apps that gojek-mobile-tests marks NO_COVERAGE. Regenerated by extract_tapmind_nav_index.py.

gtf_source.note: Second automation source repo (gtf-mobile-tests, GoPay-focused: gopay-consumer-app, gopay-merchant-app, gopay-kyc-mob-web).
